company.name: Globality
company.shortDescription: Globality is an AI-driven sourcing and procuremen company that utilizes advanced AI to create accurately scoped requirements.
company.description: Globality is a technology company that connects global companies with the best suppliers at the right price for any sourcing need across every service category. Globality is bringing digital transformation to the sourcing industry through its AI-powered Platform and Smart Sourcing technologies. Globality’s AI digital solution replaces the archaic analog Request for Proposal, efficiently and effectively scoping needs, managing demand, matching companies with outstanding suppliers that meet their specific service needs, and cutting the sourcing process from months to hours while delivering savings of 20% or more.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $47,000,000, or 13.15% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $39,788,135 to $1,267,706,971, a 31.86x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
